newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Spain Banco Santander buys 55pct of Colombian bank.
newsitem.headline: Spain Banco Santander buys 55pct of Colombian bank.

text.p: Spain's Banco Santander has agreed to buy a 55 percent stake in Colombia's Bancoquia bank, said officials of the industrial group to which the Colombian bank belongs.
Bancoquia is the eighth largest bank in Colombia in terms of assets and was controlled by brewing giant Bavaria, part of the Santo Domingo conglomerate.
The deal is subject to approval by the banking authorities of both countries.
According to an official release, Banco Santander will pay $151 million for the 55 percent stake.
Under the deal, Bancoquia will sell its holdings in investment bank Corfinorte, in Colsabank, and in the warehousing group Almagran.
Bancoquia will then buy 100 percent of Colombia's largest private finance company Invercrdito.
Bancoquia, which had 128 branches throughout the country as of last March, has assets of $1.39 billion.

"We're very satisfied with this operation," said Emilio Botn, chairman of the Grupo Santander group, in a statement. "Bancoquia without doubt fits into our strategy of expansion in Latin America and shows the confidence that Santander has in the future of Colombia. We believe the offices of Bancoquia and Invercredito offer an excellent platform for commercial banking and personal credit."

The last Spanish bank to express interest in Colombia was Banco Central Hispanoamericano, which said in September it intended to buy a stake in the Banco de Colombia. That operation has not yet been realized.
